annotation.interpretation_a: The Location value is a complete URI without a '#' and any following characters.
annotation.interpretation_b: The Location value is a path component without a '#' and any following characters, assuming a base URI is implicitly defined elsewhere.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'does not have a fragment component' is open to interpretation. It's unclear whether it refers to the complete absence of a '#' character and subsequent fragment identifier, or simply the absence of a fragment identifier when the Location value is considered as a path relative to a base URI. This difference affects how the original fragment is inherited.
annotation.missing_information: The specification does not explicitly define what constitutes a 'fragment component' in the context of the Location value. Is it only the '#' and everything after it, or does it also include any preceding path information that might be considered part of the fragment?
